theme: 教材字彙・進階 650–750 第 40 群

items.pos: adj. 最後的；最終的 | n. 期末考；決賽
items.colloc: final decision 最後決定 | final approval 最終核准
items.distinct: last 最後的（順序）| ultimate 終極的
ex: The final report is due next Friday.
最終報告將於下週五截止。
We reached a final decision this morning.
我們今天早上達成了最終決定。
Please review the final version of the contract.
請審閱合約的最終版本。

items.pos: v. 完成；結束 | n. 結尾；最後階段
items.colloc: finish the project 完成專案 | finish on time 按時完成
items.distinct: complete 完成（強調完整）| terminate 終止（合約）
ex: I need to finish this report by noon.
我需要在中午前完成這份報告。
Our team finished the task ahead of schedule.
我們團隊超前進度完成了任務。
Have you finished reading the meeting minutes?
你看完會議記錄了嗎？

items.pos: n. 公司；商號 | adj. 堅固的；堅定的
items.colloc: law firm 法律事務所 | accounting firm 會計師事務所
items.distinct: company 一般公司 | corporation 大型企業
ex: She works for a top consulting firm.
她在一家頂尖顧問公司工作。
The firm specializes in international trade law.
這家事務所專精於國際貿易法。
Our firm is expanding its market share.
我們公司正在擴大市場佔有率。

items.colloc: book a flight 訂機票 | flight attendant 空服員
items.distinct: trip 旅行（過程）| journey 長途旅行
ex: My flight to Tokyo departs at eight.
我飛往東京的班機八點起飛。
Due to bad weather, the flight was delayed.
由於惡劣天氣，航班延誤了。
I have to catch an early morning flight.
我必須趕搭早班飛機。

items.pos: n. 地板；樓層 | v. 鋪地板
items.colloc: on the third floor 在三樓 | floor plan 平面圖
items.distinct: level 水平；樓層 | ground 地面
ex: Our office is located on the tenth floor.
我們的辦公室位於十樓。
Please show the client the new floor plan.
請向客戶展示新的平面圖。
The warehouse floor needs to be cleaned.
倉庫地板需要清理。

items.colloc: user-friendly 易於使用的 | environmentally friendly 環保的
items.distinct: kind 仁慈的 | amiable 和藹的
ex: The sales team provided friendly service today.
銷售團隊今天提供了友善的服務。
Our new software is very user-friendly.
我們的新軟體非常容易上手。
She maintains friendly relations with all clients.
她與所有客戶維持友好的關係。

items.colloc: generally accepted 普遍接受的 | generally speaking 一般來說
items.distinct: usually 通常 | mostly 大部分
ex: Generally speaking, the project is moving well.
一般來說，這個專案進展順利。
This policy is generally accepted by employees.
這項政策普遍受到員工接受。
The office is generally quiet in the mornings.
辦公室早上通常很安靜。

items.colloc: gentle reminder 溫馨提醒 | gentle slope 平緩的斜坡
items.distinct: mild 輕微的 | soft 柔軟的
ex: A gentle reminder that the deadline is tomorrow.
溫馨提醒截止日期是明天。
The manager gave a gentle critique of my work.
經理對我的工作提出了溫和的批評。
Please handle the fragile equipment with care.
請輕柔地處理這些易碎設備。

items.colloc: take a holiday 休假 | public holiday 國定假日
items.distinct: vacation 休假（美式）| break 休息時間
ex: The office will be closed for the holiday.
辦公室將於假期期間關閉。
Are you planning to take a holiday soon?
你打算近期休假嗎？
We expect more sales during the holiday season.
我們預期在假期期間銷售額會增加。

items.colloc: agenda item 會議項目 | item list 商品清單
items.distinct: object 物體 | article 物品（文章）
ex: Please review each item on the agenda.
請審閱議程上的每一個項目。
This store offers a wide range of items.
這家店提供多樣化的商品。
Check the shipping list for every item.
核對出貨清單上的每一項物品。

items.pos: n. 新聞記者；新聞工作者
items.colloc: investigative journalist 調查記者 | freelance journalist 自由撰稿記者
items.distinct: reporter 報導者 | editor 編輯
ex: A journalist interviewed our CEO yesterday.
一名記者昨天採訪了我們的執行長。
The journalist covers global economic news.
該記者報導全球經濟新聞。
Many journalists attended the press conference.
許多記者參加了這場記者會。

items.colloc: business journey 商務旅程 | long journey 長途旅行
items.distinct: trip 短途旅行 | voyage 海上航行
ex: The journey to the factory took three hours.
前往工廠的旅程花了三個小時。
Starting a new business is a challenging journey.
創業是一段充滿挑戰的旅程。
She documented her journey across the country.
她記錄了她橫跨全國的旅程。

items.colloc: legal advice 法律諮詢 | legal action 法律行動
items.distinct: lawful 合法的（符合法律）| legitimate 合理的
ex: We need to seek legal advice for this contract.
我們需要為這份合約尋求法律建議。
The company is taking legal action against them.
公司正對他們採取法律行動。
Ensure all documents follow legal requirements.
確保所有文件符合法律要求。

items.colloc: full length 全長 | length of time 時間長度
items.distinct: distance 距離 | width 寬度
ex: The length of the contract is two years.
合約的長度為兩年。
Please adjust the length of your presentation.
請調整你簡報的長度。
Consider the length of time for the training.
考慮一下訓練所需的時間。

items.pos: adj. 充滿活力的；熱鬧的
items.colloc: lively discussion 熱烈的討論 | lively atmosphere 熱鬧的氣氛
items.distinct: active 活躍的 | energetic 精力充沛的
ex: The team had a lively discussion about strategy.
團隊針對策略進行了熱烈的討論。
There was a lively atmosphere at the expo.
博覽會現場氣氛十分熱鬧。
She gave a lively presentation to the investors.
她為投資人帶來了一場充滿活力的簡報。

items.colloc: lunch menu 午餐菜單 | drop-down menu 下拉式選單
items.distinct: list 清單 | catalog 目錄
ex: Could you please bring us the lunch menu?
可以請你拿午餐菜單給我們嗎？
Click the file menu to save the document.
點擊檔案選單來儲存文件。
The seasonal menu changes every three months.
季節性菜單每三個月更換一次。

items.colloc: art museum 美術館 | visit a museum 參觀博物館
items.distinct: gallery 畫廊 | exhibition 展覽
ex: The museum is closed on Mondays for maintenance.
博物館週一休館進行維護。
We organized a trip to the local museum.
我們組織了一趟參觀當地博物館的行程。
The new museum wing opens next month.
博物館的新展館將於下個月開幕。

items.colloc: obviously true 明顯正確的 | obviously disappointed 顯然很失望
items.distinct: clearly 清晰地 | apparently 似乎
ex: The client was obviously pleased with the design.
客戶顯然對設計感到滿意。
She is obviously the most qualified for the job.
她顯然是最有資格勝任這份工作的人。
There is obviously a misunderstanding regarding the terms.
關於條款顯然有誤解。

items.colloc: business owner 企業主 | property owner 房產所有人
items.distinct: holder 持有人 | landlord 房東
ex: The owner of the company approved the budget.
公司所有人批准了這份預算。
Contact the building owner regarding the repairs.
針對修繕問題聯繫建物所有權人。
He is the proud owner of this small bakery.
他是這家小型烘焙坊的自豪店主。

items.colloc: professional photographer 專業攝影師 | hire a photographer 聘請攝影師
items.distinct: journalist 記者 | artist 藝術家
ex: We hired a professional photographer for the event.
我們為這場活動聘請了一位專業攝影師。
The photographer captured great shots of the team.
攝影師捕捉了團隊精彩的照片。
She works as a freelance photographer for magazines.
她擔任雜誌的自由攝影師。
